outputs.explanation: The spatial expression panels are heatmap-style overlays (Log2 Exp color scale) on tissue sections; each spot already represents an individual spatial measurement rather than an average, so heatmaps are exempt from requiring separate individual-point overlays.
Panel B consists of H&E and RNAscope fluorescence micrographs, not a quantitative plot showing averaged data, so the check does not apply.
The plot shows median with 95% CI, but each individual tumor sample (LUAD n=512, LUSC n=500) is plotted as a separate dot, so individual data points are displayed alongside the summary statistic.
The bar chart shows mean ± SD, with individual replicate values (dots, n=3 per group) overlaid on each bar.
